name: pixel-animate-text
title_zh: 像素小人从第一帧起跳，动作词驱动逐帧动画
tagline_zh: 不用逐帧手绘，不用懂骨骼绑定。给一个起手帧和一句“走路/挥剑/待机”，它按姿势生成关键帧，循环播放像老式街机角色。
tagline_en: No frame-by-frame drawing. Give one sprite and "walk" or "slash" — it generates pose-keyed frames for a clean.
desc_en: Animate a pixel-art character or object from a text action description — walking, jumping, waving, attacking, idle — starting from a single first frame (user-provided or generated). Use when the user says "animate this sprite", "make it walk", "generate a walk cycle", "animate with text", "walking forward 4 frames", or provides one static frame plus an action. Handles pose-keyed frame generation w
why_zh: 姿势锚定帧生成，动作词映射到帧序列，不靠插值糊弄，每帧都是独立像素画，循环自然不生硬。
why_en: Pose-anchored generation, not tweening. Each frame is a distinct pixel drawing, so cycles loop without warping artifacts.
limit_zh: 只认像素风单帧输入，动作限于描述词库（走/跳/挥/待机等），输出为帧序列图，不含合成GIF或视频，需自行拼接。
limit_en: Pixel art only; actions limited to built-in word list; outputs raw frame sheets, no GIF/video export or auto-stitching.
title_en: Pixel sprite animation from one frame, driven by action.
